mandate: Determine whether A0T response-guided LR control is genuine adaptive control or only discovers a global LR scaling direction. OFFLINE analysis of frozen A0T artifacts ONLY. No new training, no controller modification, no new optimization.
inputs_frozen_readonly: outputs/a0t_response_lr_control_pilot_v01/runs/cells.jsonl (36 cells: chi_lr, action_u, aliased, losses A/B/C at H in {4,16,64})

analyses_frozen.1_action_distribution: P(+0.05), P(-0.05) pooled and per seed (across datasets), and per dataset.
analyses_frozen.2_action_entropy: H(a) = -sum p log2 p in bits, pooled and per seed. H=0 means single global action.
analyses_frozen.3_switching_statistics: per (dataset, seed, stream) trajectory ordered by bank step (D1: 46,52,64,82; D2: 46,82): number of action sign changes; summary distribution. Max possible: 3 (D1), 1 (D2).
analyses_frozen.4_fixed_strategy_comparison: using EXISTING rollout gains only: fixed +0.05 = arm B (36 cells), native = arm A, response = arm C. Fixed -0.05 exists in A0T artifacts ONLY on the cells where the guided action was -0.05 (non-aliased, chi>0) -- comparison restricted accordingly and labeled. No arm invented, no rollout imputed.
analyses_frozen.5_gain_decomposition: response_gain = gain_C; best_fixed_gain = max over AVAILABLE fixed arms per cell (only +0.05 for 34 aliased cells; max(+0.05, -0.05) for the 2 non-aliased cells where the -0.05 rollout exists as arm C); adaptive_gain = gain_C - best_fixed_gain. IDENTIFICATION LIMIT (pre-registered): on aliased cells adaptive = 0 by construction; on non-aliased cells adaptive = min(gain_C - gain_B, 0) = 0 wherever the guided -0.05 beat fixed +0.05. Therefore the adaptive component is additionally reported as the per-cell directed benefit on non-aliased cells (gain_C - gain_B there) with the explicit caveat that a pooled adaptive test is UNDERPOWERED (n=2 discriminative cells) and that a full adaptive test would require fixed -0.05 rollouts on all cells (not present in frozen artifacts; NOT generated - no new training allowed).

interpretation_cases.case_B: adaptive gain ~ 0 -> response discovers global LR scaling
interpretation_cases.case_C: response worse -> local response does not translate

analyses_frozen.verdict_rule_frozen: Report all three cases with evidence. Primary verdict: Case_B confirmed if pooled adaptive gain (as computable) shows no significant positive adaptive component AND fixed +0.05 gain is significantly positive; Case_A evidence reported descriptively from the n=2 discriminative cells (direction and magnitude, no inferential claim); Case_C ruled out if response_gain median > 0 significant (already established in A0T).

forbidden: imputing or simulating fixed -0.05 losses on cells where they do not exist
deliverables: CSV tables (action distribution, per-cell decomposition, switching)
stop_rule: STOP after analysis. Do not auto-launch any next round.
